title: Canva secret layouts outside the context claim
summary: A bare cnvca-prefixed string with no carrier and a Basic envelope whose token is split across lines.
rationale: Canva states the prefix but no separator, length or alphabet, so a bare prefixed string has no basis for a detector of its own, and a split envelope depends on a parser.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted: the layouts are frozen as unsupported variants. No new bare-prefix expectation is created.

sources.supports: client_secret string Optional Your app's client secret, for authenticating the request. Begins with cnvca .
